details:
I don't blame you for changing the button layout.
I like that it's wider and shallower than before, but it has a cluttered image.
I would like to be able to edit the Launch Pad QuickLinc.
I'd like to be able to change what I use most often depending on who I am.
I'd like to see the camera in the "select User" area instead of a tab.
I'd like to be able to change the order of the camera settings if I can't see them all at once.
I'd like to be able to change the order of the camera settings.
I use the 5 second timer more often than the filters
Please change the color of the camera itself to orange when using the photo camera and stream camera. Or display them in a way that you can tell.
(To prevent accidents where you think it's a stream camera but it's a photo camera)
It's a shame that the same Wings appear on both sides.
I want to customize it.
I'd like to see updates and events at the top of the Launch Pad, but only when I log in. It's not good that it's taking up so much space. It's too big.
The Exit button is still too deep in the settings and the icon is too confusing.
I'm writing this because I'm enjoying VRChat.
I wish for VRChat to be better.
